objective: Train and strengthen the model using available public data and permissible AlphaGenome results

checks.requirement: Final selected weights, roles, plans and training code match pre-evaluation lock
Actual final gradient training completed, with changed weights and exact fixed epoch histories
checks.qualification: Source HyenaDNA/PWM encoders remain fixed in final versions; AlphaGenome itself was not fine-tuned.

checks.requirement: Training rows and held chromosomes are disjoint
checks.qualification: Only strict Siraj subset is the new primary molecular check; Salomon study was previously used.

checks.requirement: Strict prior-region exclusion was set before reserved evaluation
checks.qualification: No guarantee of absence from foundation-model resources/public papers.

checks.requirement: Permissible AVI supervision/input collection completed with explicit missingness
checks.qualification: No detailed API outputs/AVI breakdowns used. Whole88GBpublisher table was not independently downloaded/hashed.

checks.requirement: Finite model comparison and independent development statistics completed
checks.qualification: Development/early-stopping/combination comparisons are not unbiased nested CV; reserved test required.

checks.requirement: Reserved evaluation and independent metric checks completed
checks.qualification: Same assay/library held chromosomes, not independent patients/donors or clinical genetic-score validation.

checks.requirement: Selected AlphaGenome-assisted models improve primary strict-assay rankings with matched comparisons
evidence: 1Mb/5Mb paired intervals both positive in strict Siraj comparisons
checks.qualification: NGN2 results are mixed; nominal intervals do not establish global optimality or clinical benefit.

checks.requirement: All33project substitutions scored with explicit assay, allele and training-overlap qualifications
checks.qualification: Genome-reference-to-other-allele molecular scores do not establish original discovery risk direction, causal genes or genetic-score validity.

checks.requirement: Human-readable report, numerical card and visually reviewed figure complete
checks.qualification: Original GWAS/NHANES scientific claims remain separate.

checks.requirement: Local inference bundle relocated successfully and frozen metrics reconstruct exactly
checks.qualification: Tested existing Mac ARM environment. Fresh installation, another OS and full retraining from this bundle alone are not verified; large training inputs remain in original worktree/SSD.

scope: Completed molecular-assay AI development/evaluation deliverable; not completion of broader Sleep–Frailty genetics/manuscript project or a patient disease-risk model.
strength_limit: Best selected by completed finite comparisons, with a real strict-assay benefit. No claim of global optimality or clinical strength.
unresolved_scientific_limits: Cross-study mixed performance, clinical calibration and population transfer
nonblocking_reproduction_limit: Local inference and frozen statistics verified; fresh platform/full retraining elsewhere not verified.
